open scoped BigOperators
theorem study_q_sine (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) : Real.sin x ≤ x
:= by
  have key_sin_le_1 : Real.sin x ≤ 1
  := by
    apply abs_le
    exact Real.sin_x_le_one
    rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
  have key_sin_le_x : Real.sin x ≤ x
  := by
    apply abs_le
    exact key_sin_le_1
    rw [abs_eq_self_of_nonneg (Real.sin_x_nonneg x)]
    exact key_sin_le_1
  exact key_sin_le_x
